info.name: Lexgo Sign API v1
info.description:
Lexgo Sign public API (v1): a ready-to-run Postman collection with tests and saved examples.

Folders are numbered and tagged. Folders tagged SAFE only create or read unsent drafts with fictional data. Folders tagged EFFECT send emails, change tenant settings, call outbound URLs or create Alerts, and are skipped unless the variable effects_confirmed is yes. Any request outside folder 0 is skipped on a production host unless production_confirmed is yes.

Set api_url, api_key (and the other variables listed in the README) in an environment. Authentication is the Authorization header with the API key; there is no collection-level auth, so the storage upload in folder 2 never receives the key.

Public documentation lives in the API docs site (pages under api/). See README.md in this bundle for setup, the variable contract and the newman commands.
